_how_to_update: TO LOG AN INCIDENT: add an entry to the 'incidents' array below with date (YYYY-MM-DD), title, status (one of: investigating | identified | monitoring | resolved), and details in plain language. Keep entries honest — no fake uptime claims. Newest entries go LAST in this file; the status page renders newest first automatically. Then re-deploy the landing.
